mdb.title: master.mdb Explorer - UmaConvert
mdb.heading: master.mdb Explorer
mdb.lede: Open the game database (master.mdb), browse its tables, turn numeric codes into names and links, and compare two versions.
mdb.hint: Despite the .mdb name this is a SQLite file, and this tool only reads it, meaning the original file is never modified. Files around 40 MB open in the browser. Names and links for numeric codes come only from a hand-verified dictionary. Connections not in it are shown separately as guesses. The file is processed only on this device and is never uploaded.

open.noTexts: There is no text_data table, so name resolution and text search are unavailable.
open.mapMissing: The mapping dictionary (mdb-map.json) could not be loaded, so name resolution, links and the domain view are limited.

tables.editLabels: Edit value labels for this column
tables.filterHint: Filter syntax under each column: text (contains) · =value (exact) · >number · <number · !text (exclude). Times are JST (UTC+9).

search.weakTitle: Every index exists in this table, but only {percent}% of its rows have the text, so this is a weak candidate.

sectionHint.holders: Found in the trainee skill sets (available_skill_set).
sectionHint.holdersGroup: A skill group bundles skills of different grades. These outfits do not have this exact skill but have another skill of the same group. Outfits already listed above are left out.
sectionHint.hints: Found in the support card hint lists (single_mode_hint_gain).
sectionHint.hintsGroup: A support card may give only one skill of a group as its hint (for example 202711 has rarity 2 and 202712 has rarity 1), so cards that give another skill of the same group are collected here. Cards already listed above are left out; see "Skills in the same group" for the group's members.

section.steps: Missions in the same step group

drawer.label: Row details
drawer.missing: This row could not be found.
drawer.textsHint: Confirmed entries are categories registered in the name dictionary; guesses are categories whose indexes largely overlap this table's ids.
drawer.textsOther: {n} texts with the same index only
drawer.textsOtherHint: These are most likely texts of other tables that merely share the number.
drawer.refsHint: Only reference columns registered in the dictionary are searched. The first search scans the related tables and can take a few seconds.
drawer.textsWeak: {n} weak guesses (only some rows have them)
drawer.textsWeakHint: Every index of these categories exists in this table, but only some of its rows have the text (for example items that only newer characters have). They are often right, but the same condition also matches unrelated tables, so they are not confirmed. Once verified, register them under tables in mdb-map.json. The percentage is the share of this table's rows that have the category.
